title: The start of a new period
hook: Two stated cases: explore a planning boundary and a stated daily rate.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a planning boundary and a stated daily rate affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Remaining, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a planning boundary and a stated daily rate in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
